name: CNT85 Inc.
summary: CNT85 Inc. specializes in the conceptualization, manufacturing, and distribution of industrial plant equipment and filter press systems. Furthermore, the company offers engineering and building solutions, in addition to property leasing and sales. Its operations are structured across three principal divisions: Plant, Filter Press, and Construction. Established on December 2, 1996, the firm's corporate headquarters are situated in Anyang-si, South Korea.
